evidence_links.relevance_note: The post-market surveillance system is an integral part of the quality management system and should actively gather relevant data on device safety. The missing clinician note documentation may indicate a gap in this system.

The quality management system should include processes for setting up, implementing, and maintaining the post-market surveillance system. The missing clinician note documentation may indicate a gap in this process.

The synthetic CI test log shows a drop in VTach sensitivity from 0.97 to 0.89, triggering the automated risk-gate block. This indicates a technical issue that was contained before clinical deployment.
The synthetic deployment log shows an update outside the documented maintenance window, which may indicate a process issue. However, no patient was exposed.
The synthetic unit test log shows VTach classifier validation passing at the time of release, indicating a coverage gap in existing tests. This may have allowed the regression to slip through.
The synthetic release checklist is missing authorized human approval, indicating a process gap in quality management. This may have contributed to the issue not being caught earlier.

report.rationale: The synthetic remote monitoring center reported a minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.
